title: The transform generation this contract's evidence belongs to
why: A fixture or a store record is evidence about the transform that produced it, and only about that one. The frozen collection was once found to hold 67 materials whose tangent numbers predated a correction and were evidence of nothing -- they looked exactly like current ones. So the current fingerprint is recorded in ONE place that both repositories read, rather than as a constant hard-coded on each side where the two can drift silently.
evidence_status: This fingerprint identifies current code as of 2026-10-03 (corpus robustness campaign B8, commit 1532ce9: the helper lifter joins a fixed-form continuation as the compilers do, so a name broken across lines stays one name). The current corpus evidence is pass21 (commits 70a3700 and bb1cf79, 2026-10-03): all 405 acquired sources re-transformed at c121f4a7ca0ad160 and every stored entry re-verified in Abaqus 2021 at harness b5ec344c5a001293 -- 102 entries verified in Abaqus under the D-4 tangent gate and 112 at the routine level, of 245 eligible -- and the 116 cases frozen at pass21 fingerprints (f4a7dab). Corpus pass20 (ab32cce7bec15c93 / a4f0ea8c9d124f18; 67 and 109 of 238 under the legacy gate) and pass16 (dbe9f928191e1d43) are history. The two Residual Assembler fixtures in tests/fixtures/verified were produced at dbe9f928191e1d43 and are history until re-frozen at this fingerprint. The verified collection under umat/ (pass12, 94a92c01814f107a), the ten fixtures under Residual Assembler tests/fixtures/historical and every earlier generation stay retired from current capability claims and regression baselines: preserve their original generation and numerical observations and read them only as history. The re-freeze procedure is documented in docs/evidence/final_refreeze.md in both repositories.
covers: every file under src/umat_oti whose suffix is .py, .f90, .f, .for or .inc, except the subpackages listed in umat_oti.store.transform_store.NOT_TRANSFORM_CODE, which cannot change a stored transform
how_to_update: Run umat_oti.store.transform_fingerprint(), put the result here, regenerate contract_lock.json, and copy both into Residual_Assembler/schemas/. Everything frozen at the previous value is now evidence about a transform that no longer exists: re-freeze it or read it only as history. This is NOT a contract version bump -- the shape of the agreement is unchanged; what changed is which evidence is current.
consumers_must: refuse a fixture whose transform_fingerprint differs from this value as a regression baseline, and treat a fixture carrying no fingerprint as NOT ESTABLISHED rather than as current
